### Hi!
I’m a 2nd year PhD student at [Rutgers Linguistics](https://ling.rutgers.edu). I’m currently working on my first QP covering the Banjara (**ISO 639-3: lmn**) vowel system. 


### Research interests
- Phonetics-phonology interface
- Fieldwork & descriptive linguistics
- Laboratory phonology

### Language families
- Turkish, specifically the Erzurum dialect
- Banjara (also known as Lambani and Gor Boli)
